bookingSteps.title: Details
bookingSteps.description: Add your main booking details and confirm the experience you want to reserve.

bookingSteps.title: Date & time
bookingSteps.description: Choose the date and time that suits your visit and availability.

bookingSteps.title: Tickets / guests
bookingSteps.description: Select the number of guests and the ticket type for the booking.

bookingSteps.title: Summary
bookingSteps.description: Review the experience, pricing, and booking details before proceeding to payment.

bookingSteps.title: Payment
bookingSteps.description: Complete the payment details and confirm the reservation securely.

bookingSteps.title: Confirmation
bookingSteps.description: Receive confirmation of your successful booking and next steps.
